title: Italian, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the real 2024-25 archived bulletin (fetched and verified via raw HTML, byte-diffed against the 2023-24 archive -- identical except the 'Other Cultures'->'World Cultures' and 'Foreign Language'->'World Language' terminology rename described below). REAL DIFFERENCE FROM 2026: the 2024-25 catalog still publishes a single unified 'Italian, B.A. at University Park Campus and Commonwealth Campuses' Suggested Academic Plan (unlike 2025/2026's split into two separate UP-only and Commonwealth-only plans) and this plan has NO 'LA 83'/'LA 283' Liberal Arts Seminar line items at all -- that 1.5+1.5=3cr Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar requirement was added to the plan starting with the 2025-26 catalog edition (confirmed by diffing the 2022/2023/2024 archives, which all agree with each other and all omit it, against the 2025/2026 editions, which both include it). This plan's own stated total is 122 credits (16+16+16+15+15+15+15+14, verified by summing the printed per-semester subtotals), vs. 2026's 125cr -- the entire gap is exactly that 3cr seminar addition; every other requirement (IT 1/2/3 sequence, IT 301/320 prescribed courses, the 9cr Additional Courses list, the 9cr 400-level list, the Dante choice IT 415/490, the 3cr Supporting Courses pool IT 130/131/225N/240Q, and the 6cr Study Abroad/400-level-related-discipline slot) is textually identical to 2026's, course-for-course. The 2024-25 catalog is the first of the archived editions to use the newer 'World Language'/'World Cultures' terminology (2022-23 and 2023-24 both still say 'Foreign Language'/'Other Cultures') -- cosmetic relabeling only, modeled here as 'Elective (World Cultures)' to match this catalog year's own wording. Campus-availability line unchanged across all 5 years: 'Begin Campus: Any Penn State Campus / End Campus: University Park' (same as 2026 -- see campus note in ITBA-2026.json; not re-added here since it does not change this file's semester sequence). Semester sequence and credit distribution otherwise directly mirrors ITBA-2026.json's modeling choices (IT-course-pool OR-groups, generic Gen Ed/Elective slots, etm flags on the IT 1->2->3 chain start and first-semester GWS course).
